authority: Project owner instruction on 2026-09-20: continue Phase 7 and work towards the exits; stop only for a genuine blocker, repair exhaustion, or a required Level 3 decision.

calculation.input_mutation: prepare_track_alignment changes four config items only after calculation and validation pass; the helpers do not change inputs

prepare_track_alignment.result_identity: fresh insertion-ordered mapping, points list, headings list and new XY points for each successful call
prepare_track_alignment.config_identity: the supplied mapping identity and each unrelated item identity stay unchanged
prepare_track_alignment.failure_state: for supported inputs, a failure before the four config updates keeps config and main_alignment unchanged

diagnostics.format_string: All spacing and width values for '{}' must be greater than zero.
The constant radius for '{}' is {:.3f} mm, which is too small for its {:.3f} mm template width.

diagnostics.condition: manual entry signed offset * side factor <= 1.0e-8
diagnostics.format_string: The manual entry Euler easement for '{}' places its entry straight on the wrong side of the main track. Change the entry length or select Platform widening.

diagnostics.condition: manual exit signed offset * side factor <= 1.0e-8
diagnostics.format_string: The manual exit Euler easement for '{}' places its exit straight on the wrong side of the main track. Change the exit length or select Platform widening.
Platform widening for '{}' needs a positive Entry transition length.
Platform widening for '{}' needs a positive Exit transition length.
The platform widening for '{}' produces a peak minimum radius of {:.3f} mm, which is too small for its {:.3f} mm template width. Increase the platform transition length or reduce the spacing change.

diagnostics.condition: alignment_mode is not one of the three supported exact values

prepare_track_alignment.nested_diagnostics: the existing selected solver and core-builder contracts
operation_order: read name and side and calculate the side factor
validate start spacing, curve spacing, finish spacing and width together
calculate the effective constant radius
validate the radius against half the width
read the alignment mode
for match-spacings mode, solve the entry transition and then the exit transition
for match-spacings mode, build the concentric core and set minimum_radius
for use-lengths mode, read the entry and exit transition lengths
for use-lengths mode, calculate the signed entry offset and then the signed exit offset
for use-lengths mode, validate the entry side and then the exit side
for use-lengths mode, build the concentric core and set minimum_radius
for platform mode, validate the entry transition length and then the exit transition length
for platform mode, calculate the main entry and exit line offsets
for platform mode, solve the entry shape and then the exit shape
for platform mode, build the platform core and add both shape parameters
for platform mode, validate the peak minimum radius
reject an unknown mode
update the four config items in their specified order
add the nine result metadata items in their specified order
return the ordered result

host_adapter.config_and_main_alignment: pass the supplied objects to the calculation one time

product_routing.selection_recovery: restore each previous selected value and remove each initially absent value after an error

scope.supported: B14/B15 numeric and qualified-FreeCAD inputs exercised by the bounded proof
preserved: Local left-turn XY millimetres and radian headings
Three exact alignment modes and their operation order
Complete diagnostics and failure order for the supported inputs
Config mutation order and unrelated input identities
Complete ordered result and fresh result identities
Native App.Vector type, order and Z value at the host boundary
Eighteen-function selection, 39 caller identities, mixed-route rejection and atomic recovery
excluded: Arbitrary custom numeric or point objects and identical failure interleaving for those objects
A failing custom vector constructor and its config side-effect sequence
Persistence, physical-platform, sectioning, validation, output or export changes
